description: Use this when a visitor asks how crowded one supported park may be within the next 30 park-local days. Resolve the park ID first. Returns a forecast and range, not a guarantee or a live wait.

date.description: First date in the park's local time zone, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

days.description: Number of consecutive days, 1 to 30; defaults to 1.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

name: parky_get_crowd_outlook
title: Get Parky crowd outlook
